source_read.visual_summary: Photographed embroidered patch with a thick green square border, coral-orange field, lavender uppercase lettering above and below a cartoon musical vignette.
surface_cues: Raised ribbed embroidery around the perimeter
Directional thread fills and pale stitched contour lines
Flatter woven orange ground against thicker stitched figures
Soft diffuse illumination with shallow thread shadows, no glossy highlights
preserve_cues: Small rounded green head with dark eyes and curved smile on a long, bending neck; rounded organic silhouette contrasts with the piano’s angular construction.
Broad tilted gray-brown body or shell marked with irregular cream spots and small protruding green appendages.
Blue grand-piano silhouette with raised diagonal lid, pale narrow keyboard, fine contour stitching and slender descending supports.
Cream musical-note motif isolated against the orange ground.
Original framing uses broad lavender letter masses above and below the vignette and a thick green perimeter; lettering may become illegible stitched marks rather than readable copy.
composition_moves: Break the enclosed, centrally overlapping emblem into two separated motif clusters: the long-necked spotted creature and the raised-lid piano, connected across substantial orange negative space by sparse cream musical marks.
Replace the original top-and-bottom lettering bands with one offset group of illegible lavender stitched shapes; interrupt the green perimeter instead of reproducing the complete square frame.

Keep the recognizable creature, spotted oval and piano construction in the new grouping; do not substitute generic textile texture or an unrelated musical metaphor. Structural regrouping is required, not merely enlargement, cropping or distress.
